post.description: The request supplies encrypted bytes and integrity metadata. INTEGIN validates tenant-scoped object handling; plaintext evidence must not be logged or placed in telemetry.

Optional pilot route. The server derives actor, tenant, organization, role, and capability from validated OIDC identity and local membership. The request must not contain tenant, organization, actor, or object-key fields. The server re-reads the contained object and verifies content type, byte count, and ciphertext digest before immutable metadata registration.
